title: ORC Senior & Junior Research Internship 2026–27
summary: Paid social-science research internships at the Odisha Research Centre in collaboration with TISS Mumbai — 15 senior (6 months) and 30 junior (3 months) positions.
eligibility: Senior: Master's in social sciences, humanities or allied fields with 55%+ (final-year MA students may apply). Junior: Bachelor's in the same fields with 55%+ (final-year BA students may apply). Economics, sociology, anthropology, history, languages, public policy and more.

prize.description: Senior interns ₹25,000/month for 6 months; junior interns ₹15,000/month for 3 months (as reported from the official guidelines).

notes: Apply through the separate Google Forms for the senior and junior tracks linked on the official page.
Stipend amounts come from a report of the guidelines PDF; confirm in the PDF before applying.
